entries.good_example:
CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)
if [[ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" == "main" ]]; then echo "Forbidden"; exit 1; fi
entries.rationale: Accidental commits to protected branches disrupt CI/CD. SS QLM mandates local branch verification before allowing write operations.
Poorly described changes make debugging impossible. SS QLM standardizes semantic commit messages for automated changelog generation.
